close_reason: Superseded by bx3z.14 resolution: there is no two-pass (no HashSet + array scan) in the current code. Closing as no-op alongside bx3z.14.
description: In crate-jmap-mail-server/src/helpers.rs, find_immutable_patch_key first does an O(1) HashSet lookup to detect an exact match, then immediately iterates IMMUTABLE_EMAIL_FIELDS linearly to retrieve the &'static str (lines 91-98). The comment says 'Return the canonical &'static str ... regardless of which spelling the client used' but the HashSet was built from the same array so the spelling IS already canonical. A contributor will wonder why two passes are needed. A clearer comment explaining that the HashSet gives O(1) detection while the array scan retrieves the pointer would help — or the code could just use find() directly on the array.
title: helpers.rs (mail-server): find_immutable_patch_key performs two passes over IMMUTABLE_EMAIL_FIELDS
